questions.prompt: Which description is closest to your job?
questions.why: Property Services pay depends on a job grade and a points assessment of the work. Labour Finland does not choose a grade for you. If you are unsure, you can view the wage table and check your employment information, employer or the relevant organisation.

publication_rule: A question may be shown only when it is required to distinguish currently valid VERIFIED wage records. Do not invent pay groups, job types or other classifications.
